email.subject: Luna Co Hair Studio - quick site note
email.body:
Hi Tom,

I checked Luna Co's website and two things are likely costing you bookings. There's no way to book online, so anyone looking after hours just leaves. And there's no click-to-call on mobile, so people have to copy your number by hand instead of tapping to call - most won't bother.

The site's also missing hours and the page title doesn't say "hair salon" or "Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in Google search.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found in a free 10-minute call, no pitch, just the specifics.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
